meta.dataset: Frontline Managed Services - mid-size US law firm target universe (40-350 attorneys, beyond AM Law 200 coverage)
meta.portfolio_company: Frontline Managed Services (Broad Sky Partners; St. Louis HQ; managed IT + revenue-cycle/eBilling for law firms)
meta.method: Candidate list of ~300 independent mid-size firms in the 16 target metros was built, then every firm website was crawled directly (homepage, about/firm/office/news pages and XML sitemaps via curl, plus WebFetch for bot-blocked sites). Attorney counts were taken verbatim from firm-website statements where available; otherwise approximated from the count of attorney bio URLs in the firm's sitemap (flagged 'approx'). Signals (mergers, office expansions, CIO/CTO roles, eBilling/billing-stack disclosures, data-security incidents) were extracted only from retrieved firm pages. Fit score is a transparent heuristic: size + client base (insurance-defense weighted for carrier eBilling/LEDES intensity) + office footprint + signals + proximity to a Frontline office, minus 3 for approximate counts.
meta.scoring_formula: 35 base; size +8 (<80) / +14 (80-149) / +18 (150-249) / +20 (250-350); client base insurance +12, corporate +6, public +3; offices >=5 +6, 3-4 +3; merger +10; cyber_incident +10; office_expansion +4 each (max 8); ebilling +5; tech_initiative +3; cio_hire +2; Frontline-office metro (NYC, St. Louis, Toledo/Ohio, Honolulu) +5; directory-approx count -3; capped at 95.
sources_summary: Firm websites (about/firm overview, office, leadership, news/press pages) - primary source for every item
Firm XML sitemaps (attorney bio URL counts for approximate headcounts)
Firm press releases on mergers/combinations (e.g., gknet.com, bergersingerman.com, wglaw.com, evans-dixon.com, lerchearly.com)
Redirect/merger evidence from firm domains (e.g., mmmlaw.com -> Taft, freeborn.com -> sgrlaw.com, mossbarnett -> cozen.com)
caveats: WebSearch quota was exhausted before this task, so NLJ 500 / Law360 400 / Business Journal book-of-lists rankings could NOT be pulled; the universe was assembled from analyst knowledge of each metro and verified firm-by-firm on firm websites. Coverage is therefore broad but not exhaustive.

attorney_count_confidence='approx' items (directory counts from sitemaps) may include paralegals/patent agents or miss unlisted lawyers; treat as +/-25%. A few (e.g., McElroy Deutsch, Genova Burns) likely undercount because their sitemaps are partial.

Firms that self-identify as Am Law 200 (Arnall Golden Gregory, Hodgson Russ) and firms believed to be Am Law 200 members (e.g., Kasowitz, McKool Smith, Keker, Robins Kaplan, Wiley, Fredrikson, Kelley Drye, Pryor Cashman, Herrick) were excluded to avoid overlap with the existing AM Law 200 dataset; Am Law membership of the remaining firms was not independently verified.
No cyber incidents at these firms other than Bassford Remele's posted notice could be verified without news search; absence of a cyber_incident signal is not evidence of no incident.
CIO/CTO signals reflect roles listed on leadership pages; hire dates were generally not stated (date=null).
estimated_it_spend_band is a headcount/footprint heuristic, not a disclosed budget.
HQ lat/lon are approximate city centroids (geo_precision='city'); office lists are parsed from street addresses on retrieved firm pages and may be incomplete.
Gallagher & Kennedy is merging into Fennemore (already in the AM Law dataset) effective 2026-12-01 - route through the Fennemore account.
Scoring weights are analyst judgment, not calibrated to Frontline win data.
